---

Set Equipment is Equipment that becomes more powerful when equipped with other pieces of the same set. If you are lucky enough to acquire all pieces from the same set you may reap very powerful increases in power.

## Characteristics[]

Set equipment has the following special attributes: unique affix stats and set modifiers that become active when two or more pieces of the set are equipped.

Set equipment has a green colored name/border, a unique name, and unique icons/models. When dropped on the ground they will be indicated by a green beam of light from the sky.

### Limitations[]

Set equipment cannot be used in crafting, meaning it cannot be shattered nor can affixes be attached to them.
